received for information: The body has acknowledged/reviewed the item. This does not itself approve the proposed project.
adopted: The specified decision-making body approved the item; check whether it was a committee or City Council.
adopted with amendments: The body adopted an amended version. The amendment text matters.
adopted without amendments: The body adopted the version presented at that stage without changing it.
referred: The item was sent to another body or person for further review or action.
deferred: The decision was delayed, rather than decided at that meeting.
staff recommendation: A proposal from municipal staff, not a decision of the committee or Council.
committee decision: An action taken by a committee, which is not automatically final City Council approval.
statutory public meeting: A meeting required by applicable legislation; check the official notice for participation rules.
ward: A geographic electoral division of Toronto. A citywide item may affect all wards.
